name: Cowardice
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, bloodrager 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, spiritualist 3, summoner/unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell imbues a single creature with a sense of deep seated despair and cowardice. On a failed save, the target of the spell is despairing.

Mythic The creature is given the despairing condition.

Enemies adjacent to the target take a -4 penalty on saves against fear.

Augmented (3rd): If you expend two uses of mythic power, the target is staggered (as if by the slow spell). The target is staggered for a number of rounds equal to your tier.
